title: JakeAI Dependency Rescue
customer_promise: Submit redacted configuration or code artifacts. JakeAI identifies supported deprecated-dependency signatures and returns an evidence-linked remediation and verification report.
customer_boundaries: Redact passwords, tokens, private keys and secrets before submission.
JakeAI does not make production changes or rotate credentials.
Review-candidate findings are not proof that a system is affected.
No-match results are not proof that a system is dependency-safe.

Exchange Online EWS findings use the October 1, 2026 phased-disablement start as a review date; permanent retirement is April 1, 2027 and applicability can differ by workload and tenant configuration.
Human verification against current vendor documentation is required before action.
